g.text: NEON uses disconnected wavelength quadrature, OLI equal channels; differences include the declared spectral weighting. No per-spectrum brightness normalization.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: All flight targets use actual held-out-flight spectra. Repeated identities are purged across dates; missing class/fold support remains in fold_support.csv. Real abundance truth is unavailable.
